description: Hidden data was written into the 4 byte 'write generation counter' field of APFS inodes. This counter normally tracks write operations but can be manipulated to store arbitrary data bytes. Each modified inode carries a 4 byte payload, and the combined data can be reconstructed from all participating inodes.
notes: The write generation counter (write_gen_counter) resides within the inode structure.
Its alteration does not affect file access or metadata integrity under normal operation.
Each inode contributes 4 hidden bytes, allowing minimal yet undetectable data embedding.
Detection requires low level inode parsing and comparison against expected sequential counter values.
